I am an associate professor at the [Department of Computer Science (DCC)](http://www.dcc.ufmg.br/) of the [Federal University of Minas Gerais (UFMG)](http://www.ufmg.br/), Brazil. I hold BSc (2005) and MSc (2007) degrees in computer science from UFMG, and a PhD (2013) in computer science from the [University of Glasgow](http://www.gla.ac.uk/), UK. I was a visiting researcher at the [Glasgow Information Retrieval Group](https://www.gla.ac.uk/schools/computing/research/researchsections/ida-section/informationretrieval/) at the University of Glasgow (2008) and at the search quality team of [Google Brazil](https://www.google.com.br/about/careers/locations/belo-horizonte/) (2012), a postdoctoral researcher within the Brazilian [National Institute of Science and Technology for the Web](https://dcc.ufmg.br/projeto/303/) (2013), and a visiting professor at the Department of Applied IT at the University of Gothenburg (2024). I am a member of the [ACM SIGIR](http://www.sigir.org/), a [CNPq](http://www.cnpq.br/) research fellow, and a former affiliate member of the [Brazilian Academy of Sciences](http://www.abc.org.br/) (2016-2020).
